Specification: This specification models a single integer-valued state variable x. The initial state sets x to 0, and the next-state relation either increments x by 1 when x is negative or leaves x unchanged when x is nonnegative. The file also defines an operator Inv as UNCHANGED x, which is an action-style expression stating that x does not change. There are no temporal properties, fairness conditions, assumptions, or proofs in this module.
